title: JobTemplate
description: A job template defines the parameters for running an Ansible playbook against an inventory of managed hosts.

id.description: The unique identifier of the job template.

name.description: The name of the job template.

description.description: A description of the job template.

job_type.description: The type of job to execute.

inventory.description: The ID of the inventory to run against.

project.description: The ID of the project containing the playbook.

playbook.description: The playbook filename to execute from the project.

forks.description: The number of parallel processes to use for execution.

limit.description: A host pattern to further limit the inventory scope.

verbosity.description: The verbosity level for job output (0-5).

extra_vars.description: Extra variables in YAML or JSON format.

ask_variables_on_launch.description: Whether to prompt for extra variables on launch.

ask_inventory_on_launch.description: Whether to prompt for inventory on launch.

ask_credential_on_launch.description: Whether to prompt for credentials on launch.

survey_enabled.description: Whether the survey is enabled for this template.

created.description: The date and time the template was created.

modified.description: The date and time the template was last modified.
